title: kit-validator output records
description: JSON Schema for ErrorRecord and WarningRecord values emitted by validate(config). Both record types share this shape; the severity field distinguishes them. v0.1.0.

ruleId.description: Stable rule identifier matching an entry in lib/rules/registry.json.

severity.description: Records with severity 'error' contribute to a non-zero exitCode.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of this specific violation.

file.description: Filesystem path to the offending file, or null when the rule is not file-scoped.

recordName.description: The Name field of the offending record, or null for type-level or file-level rules.

field.description: The offending attribute name, or null when the rule does not point at a specific attribute.
